title: selfdef bitnet schedule.json (SD-R28 + SD-R46)
description: Per-GPU role assignment emitted by the bitnet-gpu-inference module's apply.sh. Consumed by sovereign-os scripts/inference/lib/pick-gpu.py (R178) to pin CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES per role. Closes SDD-019 T-6 (cycle-2 schedule.json schema gap).

schema_version.description: Operator-stable schema version. Major bump on incompatible change; consumers refuse unknown majors.

generated_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this schedule was written.

rationale.description: Operator-readable explanation of WHY this schedule was chosen (e.g. ranking criteria).

schedule.description: Per-GPU role assignment, ordered by descending VRAM (largest-VRAM card gets 'model_inference').

role.description: Workload class this GPU hosts. model_inference = primary inference; auxiliary = tokenizer/embedding/TTS; spare = idle reserve.

model_hint.description: nvidia-smi model name (e.g. 'NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell'). Optional — present when the SD-R13 enrichment ran.

vram_bytes.description: Total VRAM. Optional — present when nvidia-smi ran.

power_limit_watts.description: Nominal power cap in whole watts. Optional — present when NVML reported it (SD-R24).
